# GlucoTrust Bites Notebook (glucotrustbites.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for GlucoTrust Bites, a chewable tablet supplement marketed to support healthy blood sugar levels in adults. Seller-named ingredients (no amounts given): cordyceps militaris, banaba leaf extract, gymnema sylvestre, amla fruit extract, cinnamon extract and vanadium; the seller's page also says "13 natural plant extracts". Suggested use per the seller: one chewable tablet a day, in the morning. 6 bottle bundle $49 a bottle ($294, free US shipping); 1 and 3 bottle prices shown at checkout; 60-day money-back guarantee by phone or email, empty bottles accepted per the seller.

IMPORTANT: GlucoTrust Bites is a supplement, not a treatment, cure or reversal for diabetes or high blood sugar, and it does not lower A1C or block resistin. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). Several ingredients may lower blood sugar and add to insulin or diabetes medicine; some may affect bleeding, the liver (cassia cinnamon coumarin) or immune treatment. Adults 18+ only; pregnant or nursing people and anyone with a medical condition should consult a physician. Seek care for shaky, sweaty or confused spells, readings far from your range, fainting or chest pain.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
